findings.current: His two years of training had made losing his sight no problem
findings.defect: The Korean says that having his vision blocked was not a problem; “losing his sight” can imply blindness rather than temporary obstruction, changing the physical detail.
findings.rationale: The source specifies 시야가 차단된 것 (his field of vision being blocked), then contrasts it with blood getting into his eyes and disrupting his composure.
findings.replacement: His two years of training had made having his vision blocked no problem

summary: The translation is faithful overall, with one minor shift in how Jin Mukyung’s vision is described.
